summary: Admit exact target aliases without switching primary checkout

delivery.outcome: Allow a named primary alias only when its HEAD, local target and observed origin target identify the same commit; preserve primary branch, dirty content and index.
nonGoals: No checkout switching or cleanup, ref update, lease takeover or authority from observation.
No acceptance of detached, ahead, behind, missing remote target, active overlapping work or stale adoption metadata.
No release or adopter rollout in this source ticket.

architecture.decision: Preserve native work-start and published-package verification. At the allocation and adoption boundaries admit named aliases only with exact HEAD/local target/origin target equality and re-observe before reservation. Existing main behavior remains unchanged.
interfaceChanges: Existing adoption plan target.branch accepts a verified named alias.
dataChanges: No target source/index/ref mutation; the existing plan digest continues to bind observed branch and HEAD.
architecture.rollback: Revert the observer change through independent protected publication; all source, index and lease evidence remains intact.

validation.evidence: Real Git alias admission preserves primary and refuses divergent/detached/missing/racing targets before reservation.
Published-plan fixture accepts only exact aliases; stale/missing target and branch changes refuse.
Affected suites, native governance, required CI and independent protected publication pass.
